india.one_line: India rolls out homegrown AI models while regulators warn of AI‑driven banking fraud.

themes.title: IndiaAI Mission launches three models
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission unveiled three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1 (26.3 billion parameters, 22 Indian languages) from Soket AI Labs, and Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B from ZenteiQ AiTech Innovations—targeted for on‑premise and offline multilingual assistance.

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models

themes.title: I4C alerts banks to AI fraud
themes.text: India's Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued an advisory urging banks, NBFCs and fintech firms to apply CERT‑In recommendations, set transaction limits and report incidents within six hours as attackers use AI agents to exploit unpatched software and payment APIs for multi‑crore fraudulent transactions.

stories.headline: India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks
I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
